chapter_title: SCOMET: Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies
title: Applicability of Weapon of Mass Development Act (WMD Act)
text: 10.07 Applicability of Weapon of Mass Development Act (WMD Act) Export of items not on SCOMET List may also be regulated under provisions of the Weapons of Mass Destruction and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005.
intent: Provide knowledge guidance for Applicability of Weapon of Mass Development Act (WMD Act).
